target.name: converted
target.description: Indicates whether a website session resulted in a purchase.

core_features.device_type: Device used during the website session.
core_features.is_repeat_session: Indicates whether the session belongs to a returning visitor.
core_features.utm_source: Marketing source associated with the session.
core_features.utm_campaign: Marketing campaign associated with the session.
core_features.utm_content: Marketing advertisement content associated with the session.
core_features.http_referer: Referring website associated with the session.

additional_time_features.session_hour: Hour of the day when the session began.
additional_time_features.session_day_of_week: Day of the week when the session began. Monday = 0 and Sunday = 6.
additional_time_features.session_month: Calendar month when the session began.

excluded_from_predictors.created_at: Original session timestamp, retained for chronological splitting and analysis.

missing_value_strategy: Missing categorical values are represented by an explicit Missing category.
